description: Delegate Dana Jones represents District 30A (Annapolis and Anne Arundel County) and the Capital Gazette has said she is “one of the most prolific lawmakers” in the State! Most recently, she led the charge battling back against Moms for Liberty as the lead sponsor of the Freedom to Read Act. This historic legislation makes Maryland one of the first states in the Nation to protect the Freedom to Read and defend our literature and librarians from book bans!
title: Delegate Dana Jones for 30A
